title: gatectl error envelope
description: Printed instead of a result on exit 1, 2, 10, 20 and 21 (and by other non-zero codes without a result). code maps to the exit code: usage and config_invalid 2, not_found 10, ambiguous 21, refused 20, failed 12, internal 1. export prints audit.jsonl or log.jsonl lines, described by audit.json and log.json; it has no cli schema.
